resources.string: You're just starting and have zero level knowledge
Can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases
Can understand sentences and frequently used expressions
Can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure
Can understand the main ideas of a complex text on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in your field of specialisation
Can understand a wide range of demanding, longer texts, and recognize implicit meaning. Can express him/herself fluently and spontaneously without much obvious searching for expressions
